a: 3 years; living, research and travel allowances vary by host country
dt: 2028 award cycle: Letter of Intent initiation by May 4, 2027 and LOI submission by May 11, 2027 (9 am ET); the application site opens mid-March 2027 and guidelines are due in December 2026
e: Within 3 years of PhD at the full-proposal deadline. Must move to a new country other than the country of nationality and not have spent more than 12 months in the host country. The Cross-Disciplinary track fits physicists moving into biology.
